intro: Pick a tier, add anything extra, and accept your selection online. Tap any service in the table to see what it includes.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.summary: Everything you need to move over, done simply.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.summary: Organized shared drives, spoofing blocked, and a tested backup.

tiers.name: Complete
tiers.summary: Business Plus with Vault legal holds, USB keys, and every add on included.

rows.label: Plan
rows.explain: The Google Workspace license {company} pays Google for. Standard is the most affordable plan with room for all of your files; Plus adds Google Vault for legal holds and retention.

rows.label: Tenant, Users
rows.explain: We create your Google Workspace, verify your domain, set baseline security, and set up an account for each person.

rows.label: Email Migration
rows.explain: All the email in your current inbox is copied into a shared office mailbox on your own domain.

rows.label: Old Gmail Forwarding
rows.explain: The old Gmail address forwards new mail to the new mailbox and auto replies with your new address. Then its password is reset and every device is signed out.

rows.label: Drive Migration
rows.explain: Essentials moves your files as is into one shared drive. Pro and Complete organize them into four separate shared drives, each with its own permissions.

rows.label: MFA
rows.explain: Everyone signs in with a password plus a code from an authenticator app on their phone. Complete adds USB security keys for up to 3 people, including the admin account.

rows.label: Drive Desktop
rows.explain: Google Drive for desktop on each PC, signed in for each person, with their Desktop, Documents, and Downloads folders backed up.

rows.label: Domain Cutover
rows.explain: Your domain’s email moves over to Google, any existing mailboxes come along, and the old email subscription is cancelled.

rows.label: Contacts/Calendar Migration
rows.explain: Contacts and calendar events move from the old account into Google Workspace.

rows.label: Scanner Email Setup
rows.explain: Your copier’s scan to email, and anything else that sends from the old account, is switched to send from your domain.

rows.label: Staff Training
rows.explain: A one hour session for your team on their new logins, the shared inbox, shared drives, and MFA.

rows.label: Runbook
rows.explain: A written record of your setup: DNS records, drive structure, admin access, and how to add or remove a user.

rows.label: SPF DKIM DMARC
rows.explain: Email security records that stop scammers from sending email as your domain. Monitor reports spoofing attempts; Enforce actively blocks them after 2 to 4 weeks of reports.

rows.label: Backup Reconfiguration
rows.explain: Your existing backup is moved to the new Workspace, covering every person’s email and files and all shared drives. Pro and Complete add a test restore and email alerts if a backup fails.

rows.label: Windows Synced User Logins
rows.explain: Each person signs into their PC with their Google Workspace login and MFA, so one login covers everything.

rows.label: Vault Retention Policies
rows.explain: Google Vault retention rules and legal holds, so email and files can’t be permanently deleted and can be searched or exported when you need them.

rows.label: Phone Policies
rows.explain: A screen lock is required, and remote wipe is ready, on any phone with company email.

rows.label: IT Policies
rows.explain: Written policies for acceptable use, passwords and MFA, and onboarding and offboarding staff.

rows.label: Hypercare
rows.explain: Support after cutover, with any issues fixed at no extra charge.

addons.name: USB Security Keys
addons.description: Physical keys for up to 3 people, the strongest protection against phishing. Keys billed at cost.

addons.name: Windows Synced User Logins
addons.description: Each person signs into their PC with their Workspace login and MFA.

addons.name: Phone Policies
addons.description: Screen lock required and remote wipe ready on every phone with company email.

addons.name: Basic IT Policies
addons.description: Short written policies for acceptable use, passwords and MFA, and onboarding and offboarding.

addons.name: Extended Hypercare, 30 Days
addons.description: Support after cutover extended to 30 days, with fixes at no extra charge.

fine_print.text: Google Workspace Standard licenses are billed separately by Google, about $14 per user per month on an annual plan.
Google Workspace Plus licenses are billed separately by Google, about $22 per user per month on an annual plan.
USB keys are billed at cost.
